a: Inductors store energy in magnetic fields.
RL and RC circuits have exponential time constants.
Resonance occurs when a system is driven at natural frequency.
Standing waves form from interfering opposite traveling waves.
Doppler ultrasound estimates blood flow speeds.
Greenhouse gases trap outgoing infrared radiation.
Specific heat is energy to raise temperature of unit mass by one degree.
Latent heat of fusion is energy to change solid to liquid at melting point.
Calorimetry measures heat transfer in physical and chemical processes.
